title: Producer Incentive Targeting Playbook Snippets
scope: Use with incentive_targeting heuristic eligibility, ranking, and budget simulation output.
disclaimer: Incentive recommendations are formula-like heuristics and should be reviewed against approved compensation plans.
eligibility_checks: Confirm producer appointment and compensation-plan eligibility.
Block or review payouts when open compliance findings exist.
Verify retention rate, loss ratio, complaint count, and premium data before communicating an award.
Apply state, carrier, and plan-specific compensation limits before final approval.
bonus_formula_notes: Base bonus is a configurable percentage of production.
Growth bonus uses incremental premium above target or growth-derived incremental premium.
Strategic product bonus is a configurable flat amount per strategic placement.
Per-producer cap should match the active compensation plan.
budget_simulation_sop: Rank producers before allocation and review top rank factors for reasonableness.
Fund eligible producers in rank order until budget is exhausted.
Document unfunded eligible producers for next-cycle review.
Re-run simulation after any manual compliance or data corrections.
